Michala M

Awesome experience
Aug 2026 • Solo
I had the most amazing meal at Air Sushi. The staff were very friendly, the food was quick to arrive but of great quality. 

Highly recommend the pan-seared salmon — absolutely delicious! I also had the edamame and the karaage Japanese fried chicken, which was so tasty and surprisingly not too greasy.

I also had a glass of red wine with dinner, and after struggling to find a really good glass of red since arriving in Da Nang, this one definitely did not disappoint! 🍷

Great food, great wine and a lovely time overall. Would definitely come back! ✨
